body.purpose: All task text, list names, labels, and button text.

motion.name: icon-hover-scale
motion.purpose: The system's only interactive feedback for icon-driven actions (trash, arrows, random, thumbs-down).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's one canonical button style, used for every primary action (Today, Plan week, Reload, Add task).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; background-color: #efefef; color: #171717; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid #171717; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.3; }

components.name: Action Icon
components.description: A clickable glyph (delete, refresh, move, etc.) whose only state treatment is a 1.5x hover scale; delete additionally turns red.
components.css: .ds-icon-action { display: inline-flex; color: #171717; cursor: pointer; margin: 0 8px; transition: transform 0.1s; } .ds-icon-action:hover { transform: scale(1.5); } .ds-icon-action.ds-icon-delete:hover { color: #ff0000; }

components.name: List Row
components.description: A single list entry in the Lists table: a folder glyph, the list name (italic when Protected), a task count, and a delete icon.
components.html: Monday✕(4)
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #171717; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-table td { padding: 6px 4px; border-top: 1px solid #efefef; } .ds-list-item { cursor: pointer; margin-left: 5px; margin-right: 15px; } .ds-list-actions { text-align: right; } .ds-list-count { text-align: right; }

components.name: Task Row
components.description: A single task row: check icon, truncated task text (strikethrough when done), and a cluster of action icons.
components.html: ○Write the quarterly report✕
components.css: .ds-table-condensed td { padding: 3px 4px; } .ds-task-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; width: 100%; } .ds-task-text { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; min-width: 120px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Plain Bootstrap-default text input used for adding tasks and lists; unstyled focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #171717; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cccccc; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; flex: 1; }

narrative.overview:
akvaratodo is a tool you reach for dozens of times a day without ever looking at the chrome. It is built on top of Bootstrap 3.3.7 (loaded straight from a CDN) for its grid, tables, forms, and Glyphicon iconography, with a thin custom stylesheet (src/todo.css) laid over it to add exactly as much personality as the workflow needs and no more. There is no brand identity to perform here: the product is a single person's daily/weekly task list, and the visual system exists only to keep that person moving fast with a keyboard, not to impress anyone.

The system is deliberately flat and terse: a near-black ink on off-white paper, one grey button shape, Bootstrap's default Glyphicon set for every action, and a single red accent reserved for destructive or attention states. Interaction feedback leans on sound and motion rather than color: every hotkey-triggered action plays an audible click, and the small action icons (trash, arrow, random, thumbs-down) scale up 1.5x on hover as their only state treatment.
keyCharacteristics: Flat by construction: no shadows, no gradients, no elevation anywhere in the system.
Bootstrap 3 is the structural and iconographic base; todo.css only adds what Bootstrap doesn't already provide.
One custom interactive primitive — the grey .rounded-button — carries almost all button chrome in the app.
Feedback is audible and kinetic before it is colorful: a click sound confirms hotkey actions, hover scales icons.
A single functional accent (red) is reserved for destructive/alert meaning; it is not a brand color.
Layout is column-constrained (Bootstrap grid, col-md-10 col-lg-8), not full-bleed, with one responsive breakpoint at 480px.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Red appears only on destructive/alert affordances (delete on hover). It never decorates a label, a heading, or a non-destructive action.

rules.name: The Inline Heading Rule
rules.body: h1/h2 are always display: inline so a heading and the action button beside it share one line — there is no stacked page-header pattern in this system.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: This system never uses box-shadow for depth or state. If something needs to read as "elevated" or "focused," reach for weight, italics, color, or transform — not a shadow.

dos: Do use .rounded-button for every button in the app — fog background, ink border and text, 4px radius.
Do keep icon feedback as a scale(1.5) hover transform, not a color or shadow change.
Do reserve red for destructive/alert meaning only (e.g. delete-on-hover); never use it decoratively.
Do play the confirmation click sound on hotkey-triggered actions, so keyboard-only use gets feedback without looking at the screen.
donts: Don't introduce shadows, gradients, or elevation anywhere — this system is flat by design.
Don't add a new icon set; Bootstrap 3 Glyphicons cover every action already in the app.
Don't add a plain unstyled native <button> anywhere — every button in the app uses .rounded-button.
